features.name: conversation
features.title: Conversation
features.what: Answers what a person says and follows the exchange within a session.

features.name: cognition
features.title: Cognition tiers
features.what: Each turn goes through the reflex tier (autonomy and the decision layer), intuition and reasoning, within their effort ceilings.

features.name: decisions
features.title: Decisions
features.what: Selects among the enabled transitions with the decision service, including the ignore when nobody is talking to floppy.

features.name: offers
features.title: Ability offers
features.what: Each turn the body reads what every ability offers from its live session (D242).

features.name: prompts
features.title: Prompts
features.what: The model-facing content each tier renders (D201) gives answers a person finds right and well put.

features.name: memory
features.title: Memory and recall
features.what: Remembers what it was told across a restart: episodes, the short-term register and long-term memory.

features.name: people
features.title: People
features.what: Knows who is talking, keeps what each person said apart, and knows when it is addressed.

features.name: persona
features.title: Persona
features.what: Revises how it talks when asked, and keeps it after a restart.

features.name: name
features.title: Its name
features.what: Adopts a name it is given, answers to it and keeps it after a restart.

features.name: learning
features.title: Learning
features.what: Learns a reflex or a routine from one instruction (lessons, reflection's selection and the revision).

features.name: builder
features.title: Builder
features.what: Writes each learned behavior as SCXML that validates and passes its simulation.

features.name: autonomy
features.title: Learned reflexes
features.what: A learned turn behavior handles the real input it was learned for, and leaves the rest to reasoning.

features.name: routines
features.title: Routines
features.what: Runs a learned routine on its schedule with no input, stops it when asked, and keeps it after a restart.

features.name: hearing
features.title: Hearing
features.what: Hears a person out loud: voice detection, speech decoding and interpretation into a turn.

features.name: turn_taking
features.title: Turn taking
features.what: Waits for the end of a person's turn across a pause, answers once, and does not take its own voice for the person's.

features.name: speaking
features.title: Speaking
features.what: Says its replies out loud, in words a person hears correctly.

features.name: voices
features.title: Voices and diarization
features.what: Tells people apart by their voices on one microphone (diarization, voice identification, people in long-term memory, #49).

features.name: consolidation
features.title: Rest and consolidation
features.what: Rests after a quiet spell, consolidates memory, and wakes on input with what it knew.

features.name: seeing
features.title: Seeing
features.what: Sees what it is shown and answers about it.

features.name: failed_turns
features.title: Failed turns
features.what: A turn that fails (a step past its bound) is handed back and remembered, so floppy still answers the person (D139).

features.name: environment
features.title: Environment and supervision
features.what: The environment activates floppy, routes sounds and sights, and supervises it with a restart budget.

features.name: reading
features.title: Reading
features.what: Reads the text of an input or an image.
features.status: not wired: nothing in the bot invokes the reading ability yet (abilities/reading/reading.scx)

features.name: emotion
features.title: Emotion
features.what: Hears the emotion in a voice.
features.status: not built: api.willen.dev serves /emotion/v1/emotion, which no floppy ability calls (D244)

features.name: voiceprints
features.title: Voiceprints
features.what: Enrolls and matches voiceprints.
features.status: not built: api.willen.dev serves /voiceprint/v1/embed, which no floppy ability calls (D244)

features.name: streaming_stt
features.title: Streaming speech decoding
features.what: Decodes speech as it streams, with the backend's turn-taking.
features.status: not built: api.willen.dev serves /v1/audio/stream, which floppy does not use (D244)
